question: What is the primary function of tele-nursing in healthcare delivery?

options.A: Providing nursing care using telecommunications technology
options.B: Replacing physical hospitals entirely with digital clinics
options.C: Conducting laboratory tests via mobile phones
options.D: Manufacturing digital health devices for hospital use

explanation: Tele-nursing relies on telecommunications and information technology to deliver nursing care and health education across physical distances. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T7#GNS113_U3_T7_h1)

question: How does tele-nursing primarily benefit rural communities in Nigeria?

options.A: By eliminating the need for any prescription medications
options.B: By providing free smartphones to every household in the village
options.C: By completely stopping the spread of infectious diseases locally
options.D: By connecting remote patients with urban healthcare expertise

explanation: Remote communities benefit when digital tools bridge geographic gaps, allowing nurses to reach patients who lack easy access to physical health facilities. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T7#GNS113_U3_T7_h1)

question: Which regulatory body governs nursing practice and tele-nursing standards in Nigeria?

options.B: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria
options.C: Federal Ministry of Information and Culture
options.D: Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria

explanation: The Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria regulates all professional nursing practice, including emerging digital modalities like tele-nursing. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T7#GNS113_U3_T7_h2)

question: What is the main difference between telemedicine and tele-nursing?

options.A: Tele-nursing only uses mobile phones whereas telemedicine requires advanced computers
options.B: Tele-nursing focuses on the nursing scope of practice while telemedicine involves physician medical services
options.C: Tele-nursing is exclusively for administrative tasks rather than clinical care
options.D: Telemedicine is illegal in Nigeria while tele-nursing is fully approved

explanation: Telemedicine is specific to medical diagnosis and treatment by doctors, whereas tele-nursing encompasses independent and collaborative nursing interventions. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T7#GNS113_U3_T7_h2)

question: Sending a photo of a skin rash via text message for a nurse to review later is an example of what?
explanation: Store-and-forward methods where information is sent and reviewed at a later time fall under asynchronous tele-nursing. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T7#GNS113_U3_T7_h3)

question: A live video consultation between a nurse and a patient is classified as what type of communication?
explanation: Synchronous communication requires both the nurse and the patient to interact in real-time simultaneously. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T7#GNS113_U3_T7_h3)

question: Why is active listening especially critical during a virtual nursing assessment?

options.A: Because physical examinations are completely forbidden in digital health
options.B: Because the nurse cannot rely entirely on physical touch or visual cues
options.C: Because patients are unable to speak clearly through electronic devices
options.D: Because digital calls automatically record and grade patient compliance

explanation: Without a traditional bedside physical exam, the nurse must depend on verbal cues and active listening to gather accurate assessment data. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T7#GNS113_U3_T7_h4)

question: What is the primary goal of virtual nursing triage?

options.A: Diagnosing complex medical conditions without a doctor
options.C: Selling digital health equipment directly to patients
options.D: Determining the urgency of care and the appropriate referral pathway

explanation: Virtual triage evaluates patient symptoms remotely to decide if they need immediate emergency care, a scheduled clinic visit, or simple home management. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T7#GNS113_U3_T7_h4)

question: Which of the following is NOT a common challenge of tele-nursing in low-resource settings?

options.A: Concerns regarding data privacy and security
options.B: Abundant and reliable electricity supply everywhere
options.C: Unstable internet or poor network connectivity
options.D: High cost of mobile data bundles for patients

explanation: Reliable electricity is frequently lacking rather than abundant in many low-resource settings, making power instability a major challenge. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T7#GNS113_U3_T7_h5)

question: Why is data security an important ethical consideration in tele-nursing?

options.A: To prevent patients from calling nurses during night hours
options.B: To protect sensitive patient health information from unauthorized access
options.C: To ensure the telecommunication company makes a high profit
options.D: To stop patients from recording their own vital signs

explanation: Using digital platforms creates a risk of data breaches, making the protection of patient confidentiality a key ethical duty for nurses. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T7#GNS113_U3_T7_h5)

question: How can nursing education prepare students for the future of digital healthcare?

options.A: By requiring students to build their own software applications
options.B: By banning the use of mobile phones in all clinical areas
options.C: By focusing exclusively on traditional paper record keeping
options.D: By incorporating digital health competencies into the basic nursing curriculum

explanation: Training student nurses in digital skills ensures the future workforce is confident and competent in delivering remote healthcare. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T7#GNS113_U3_T7_h6)

question: What is a key requirement for sustaining tele-nursing programs in resource-limited settings?

options.A: Removing government oversight from digital health operations
options.B: Discontinuing all physical hospital services permanently
options.C: Relying entirely on free international software donations
options.D: Investing in reliable infrastructure and power backup systems

explanation: Sustainable tele-nursing relies heavily on foundational investments in stable internet infrastructure and reliable power sources. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T7#GNS113_U3_T7_h6)
